key_notes: Key 1 (t=5.06s): Initial archival pose of broom; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=6.18s): Mid-sequence articulation of broom; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=7.42s): Peak dynamic extension of broom over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=8.66s): Follow-through and settle of broom with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of broom (5.06s..8.66s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
